final_candidates.decision_summary: N334 is part of an N-X-S/T glycosylation motif (N334-S335-H336). Removing this glycan may expose receptor-binding surface residues and enhance ephrin-B2/B3 engagement, increasing entry efficiency.

K501 is in the head domain near the receptor-binding region. Neutralizing this positive charge may improve receptor contact geometry or reduce electrostatic repulsion with ephrin-B2/B3, enhancing binding affinity.

Q530 is near the C-terminus of the head domain. Substitution to alanine may alter local conformational dynamics affecting F-triggering efficiency or oligomerization stability, potentially favoring fusion activation.

stop_reason.detail: No external tools available; further self-iteration without structural or experimental data is unlikely to improve the top-3 ranking.
